prompt: Create a cinematic fashion editorial portrait of a young East Asian woman in her early 20s standing perfectly still in the center of a busy modern transit hall or office lobby while blurred commuters rush past on both sides. She faces the camera directly with a calm, slightly melancholic neutral expression, hands in her trouser pockets, shoulders relaxed, full body framed from mid-thigh upward. She has short messy black layered bob with wispy bangs and a few strands across her face, natural minimal makeup, soft skin texture, and dark focused eyes. Dress her in an elegant monochrome ivory white tailored suit: single-breasted blazer with sharp lapels, matching high-waisted pleated trousers, and a ribbed turtleneck sweater underneath. The background is an airy architectural interior with tall pale columns, glass and stone surfaces, cool gray-green tones, and a polished floor; all surrounding people are anonymous motion-blurred silhouettes, creating long horizontal streaks and a strong contrast between stillness and movement. Use shallow depth of field, realistic photography, soft natural window light from the left, subtle rim light on hair and shoulders, muted teal-gray color grading, slight film grain, high dynamic range, and a contemplative urban atmosphere. Vertical 2:3 composition, eye-level camera, 50mm editorial lens look, crisp focus only on the subject, no text, no logos, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影感时尚编辑肖像，画面主体为一位 20 岁出头的东亚女性，她完美地静止站立在繁忙的现代交通大厅或办公大楼大厅中央，两侧是匆匆走过的模糊通勤人群。她直视镜头，表情平静，略带忧郁，双手插在裤兜里，双肩放松，取景范围为大腿中部以上全身。她留着 黑色凌乱短发，层次感波波头，带有轻薄刘海，几缕发丝垂在脸颊，妆容自然极简，皮肤质感细腻，双眸深邃专注。为她穿上一套优雅的单色 象牙白 定制西装：单排扣西装外套配有挺括的翻领，搭配同色系高腰百褶长裤，内搭罗纹高领毛衣。背景是开阔的建筑室内空间，拥有高大的浅色立柱、玻璃与石材表面，色调为冷灰绿色，地面光洁；周围的所有人都是匿名且动态模糊的剪影，形成了长长的水平线条，在静止与运动之间产生强烈的对比。使用浅景深、写实摄影风格，左侧柔和的自然窗光，发丝和肩部带有微妙的轮廓光，柔和的青灰色调，轻微的胶片颗粒感，高动态范围，营造出一种沉思的都市氛围。垂直 2:3 构图，平视视角，50mm 编辑镜头质感，仅主体清晰对焦，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。
